result_text:
The `all_files.zip` export now looks up and names its entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer breaks it.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` (`exportJson()`, around lines 641–652). The five hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the five scope aspects. Each entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that names the loose files, so the two can't drift apart. Entry order is still main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

I did not run the renamed-aspect scenario end to end. The reports module tests pass offline. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the zip should contain `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in fourth place and `git-history.zip` should be written, but that is from reading the code, not from a run.

I did not commit.
